source.title: WCA World Championship 2019 in Melbourne, Australia
source.content:
We are informing you that the winning candidate to host the WCA World Championship 2019 is **Melbourne**, **Australia**!


We believe that their plan was the strongest among the four candidates and that their team will lead to a successful championship next year.


Thank you to the applicants from Brest, Belarus and Beijing/Guangzhou, China for their submissions. You can view all of the application documents [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Q_KJo0UVs0kzL0YDpjm_EhipAQCFu5vZ).

translation.title: 2019 WCA 世锦赛将在澳大利亚墨尔本举行
translation.content:
我们现公布，**澳大利亚墨尔本**成功获得 **2019 WCA 世锦赛**的主办权！

我们认为，在四个申办方案中，墨尔本的方案最为出色，相信他们的团队将在明年成功举办本届世锦赛。

感谢白俄罗斯布列斯特，以及中国北京、广州的申办团队提交方案。全部申请材料可在[这里](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Q_KJo0UVs0kzL0YDpjm_EhipAQCFu5vZ)查看。
